NurseObserveGame.tsx implements the exact D from game_spec_v1.json: 7 observation cards (3 independently-random scored evidence items plus 4 fixed unscored cards), a per-item mark that only unlocks after that card is opened, a mandatory share checkbox that only unlocks once all 3 evidence items are marked, a confirm button that stays disabled (fail-closed) until sharing is checked, a single non-retryable commit, and a Gate G non-scored reflection re-presenting all 3 evidence items' actual observations and the child's real prior marks read-only on any mismatch before Gate H's distinct onPartialComplete outcome.
